name: leehogwang-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins and mods by leehogwang

plugins.name: summary
plugins.description: /summary: summarize the session you are in with Haiku (goal, done, decisions, open, todo, what to remember); later runs send only what came after

plugins.name: see-parent
plugins.description: After /fork, the session you forked from stays open in a pane: read it, and keep talking to it

plugins.name: call
plugins.description: /call: pick an installed AI CLI (claude, codex, agy, opencode) and chat with it in a side pane, in the folder you work in

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: /replay: step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time (from anthropics/claude-code-playground, Apache-2.0)
